experiment: Experiment E: Distributed Cloud Monte Carlo Simulation on Modal
conclusions: Under isotropic Poisson realizations with the exact Quaia/Galactic plane cut (|b| < 10 deg), the null distribution yields D = 0.0051 +/- 0.0006. The observed Quaia dipole amplitude D_obs = 0.0729 lies more than 100 standard deviations above the kinematic CMB expectation, confirming that the discrepancy cannot be explained by Poisson noise or partial-sky window function suppression.
